title: Legal pluralism and interethnic land conflict in the development of the Nusantara capital area, East Kalimantan, Indonesia
core_idea: Investigate how migration, multiple land tenure systems, and interethnic relations shape social dynamics and land conflict in the development zone of Indonesia’s new capital (IKN) using a qualitative case study.
tldr: A qualitative case study (in-depth interviews with migrants and participant observation, analyzed thematically) examining the interactions among migration, statutory and customary land systems, and interethnic relations in the Nusantara capital development area to better understand drivers of social dynamics and land contestation.
